action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull and rebuild
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git stash drop && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())

# Fix package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /opt/areloria && sed -i "/private.*true/a\\  \\"type\\": \\"module\\"," package.json 2>/dev/null || true')

# Build  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && rm -rf server/dist && pnpm --filter @wasd/server run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check dist
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nDist check:", stdout.read().decode())

# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 10 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 || true")
print("\n=== Run ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:600])

client.close()
EOF
